item.title: Week 11: Buccaneers at Lions
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: DET -6.5 · O/U 46.5 | Model DET 74% vs. market 74% | Tampa Bay has to turn its 9th-ranked explosive rate into chunk gains, because its passing offense sits last in EPA and Detroit's defense allows 9.4% explosives. Baker Mayfield runs into a Detroit pass rush that ranks among the league's best at 23% pressure, while Jared Goff sits well ahead of him at 12th. Our model matches the market at 74% for Detroit, with the starting quarterback edge doing most of the work at 3.3 points.
